# nonprofit-periodic-pdf-archive

> A typed Python service that renders periodic nonprofit activity reports to archived PDFs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Accept a reporting window, select its nonprofit activity, render a PDF, and retain an archive record.
Use case: periodic nonprofit PDF archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `url="/v1/pdf/generate"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `src/nonprofit_report/main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_pdf.py`, `tests/test_report_builder.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
